question.text: The above is a plot of binding energy per nucleon $E_b$, against the nuclear mass $M ; A, B, C, D, E, F$ correspond to different nuclei. Consider four reactions: (i) $A+B \rightarrow C+\varepsilon$ (ii) $\mathrm{C} \rightarrow \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\varepsilon$ (iii) $\mathrm{D}+\mathrm{E} \rightarrow \mathrm{F}+\varepsilon$ and (iv) $F \rightarrow D+E+\varepsilon$ where $\varepsilon$ is the energy released? In which reactions is $\varepsilon$ positive?

solution.text: Reaction is fusion and $4^{\text {th }}$ reaction is fission.
